Father Kills Wife and Daughter in Lucknow; Arrested

In Krishna Nagar, Lucknow, a double murder occurred where a father allegedly killed his wife and daughter. The accused, identified as a Home Guard named Ravindra Shankar, is alleged to have strangled his wife, Shyama Dulari, and daughter, Pooja Sahu, with a data cable. Police have taken the suspect into custody and are questioning him. A forensic team is also investigating the scene.
